title: Decision: PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON on every connection open
description: lib.rs line 127 enforces foreign_keys=ON in init_conn(), called on every Store::open or Store::open_in_memory. SQLite defaults to OFF, making FK constraints advisory. This design choice prevents data corruption from orphaned references (e.g., messages referencing non-existent chats). Enforcement happens in code, not config, so it travels with the binary. Tests verify it's actually ON (tests in lib.rs).
